Tribunal

Queue

corpus · Case 210

No-show fee

Driver charged me $6 for no show at Changi T1 but I was standing at Door 6 the whole time.

Filed by
Rider
Amount contested
SGD 6.00
Status
Sent to a reviewer: the judge escalated under the policy JUDGE_ESCALATE

No automated ruling was issued. A human reviewer decides this case.

Ruling

Why a reviewer: the judge escalated under the policy JUDGE_ESCALATE

No money moves. The disputed amount is held.

A reviewer decides within 24 hours of entry, or within 2 hours when the case carries a safety flag.

Escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues, so there is nothing for POL-GEN-05 to execute and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

What each side argued

The rider advocate

discarded The cancellation fee is chargeable only if the driver held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force, and for this AIRPORT pick-up that period is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec is 480, matching fee_schedule minimum_dwell_sec for AIRPORT). POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's arrival tap. The driver's own trace shows one continuous qualifying in-geofence run of 255 seconds, from 23:42:21 to 23:46:36 - some 225 seconds short of the minimum, at an arrival radius of 150 m for AIRPORT. Limb (c) is not satisfied and the fee is not chargeable. I disclose that EV-GPS-00210 is impaired - CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD, weight 0.25 - and the point survives the discount because the shortfall is separately corroborated by the trip record below.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-TRIP-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.4 but does not name its issue code(s): CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT

discarded Where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short of the free waiting period in force, POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages, and it pays the driver nothing. The derived arrival block puts the accumulated in-geofence dwell at 0.0 seconds across 0 runs with a shortfall of 480.0 seconds, and the single qualifying run the trace does show is 255 seconds. The whole SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line therefore falls and no driver compensation is payable. EV-GPS-00210 is impaired as disclosed above (weight 0.25); EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and fixes the amount at SGD 6.00.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-FARE-00210 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.25 but does not name its issue code(s): CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD

discarded Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is independently unsatisfied. The trip record's 'arrived' event is stamped 23:42:10, and limb (b) requires the trace to place the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius at or before that timestamp. The trace's only qualifying in-geofence fixes are the five that make up the run beginning 23:42:21 - qualifying_fix_count is 5 and longest_qualifying_run.fix_count is 5 - so no qualifying fix exists at or before the arrival event, and the four earlier fixes (23:34:50, 23:37:45, 23:38:23, 23:39:15) do not qualify against the arrival-radius test at all. POL-NS-02 therefore does not place the driver at the pin when the marker was pressed.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.25 but does not name its issue code(s): CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD

kept The platform's own trip record corroborates the shortfall on its own arithmetic, so this point does not depend on the trace. arrived_at is 23:42:10 and cancelled_at is 23:49:05, and the record reports wait_time_min of 6.9 - roughly 414 seconds. Even read in the manner most favourable to the driver, the platform's own record shows the wait falling about 66 seconds short of the 480 second AIRPORT minimum. I disclose that EV-TRIP-00210 is impaired (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4, because its arrival and implied wait cannot be reconciled with the trace); the point survives the discount because the two records disagree about the size of the shortfall but not about its existence.

evidence EV-TRIP-00210, EV-FARE-00210 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-GEN-02

discarded The driver's arrival tap cannot start the waiting clock, and the record itself shows why. trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed route does not apply and arrival must be proved on the exported trace. That trace is impaired under POL-NS-08(a): its device stamps run 228 seconds ahead of the server, and its last fix is 23:46:36 against a recorded termination of 23:49:05 - a 149 second disagreement on termination alone. Neither the arrived event nor the termination can be safely matched to a fix, so POL-NS-05 cannot be run to recompute the clock either, and the dwell must run from the trace's own first qualifying in-geofence fix at 23:42:21.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-12

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.25 but does not name its issue code(s): CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD

discarded The trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely at schema level: five fixes fall inside the wait the record itself asserts (23:42:21, 23:43:13, 23:44:05, 23:45:44, 23:46:36 against a 23:42:10 to 23:49:05 window), which is fewer than the six POL-NS-08(b) requires, and a 186 second sampling gap sits across the moment of geofence entry. Under POL-GEN-02(2) any finding that rests on this artifact is capped at its weight_multiplier of 0.25, below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-NS-08 closes by capping a ruling whose only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired and routing the case to review. On this evidence the driver cannot carry limb (c) and the SGD 6.00 fee cannot be collected; at the very least it is held. I name the issue codes again: CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-GEN-02, POL-NS-09

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-TRIP-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.4 but does not name its issue code(s): CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT

discarded EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING: no traffic advisory covers the Changi T1 arrival kerb in this window, and its absence is itself citable. That matters, because POL-NS-06(i) is the only route by which a driver may accumulate separate in-geofence intervals toward the minimum, and it requires a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. With the artifact missing, limb (i) is unavailable - the derived block records it unavailable for a missing traffic_advisory, with run_count 0 and 0.0 seconds accumulated - so there is no lawful reason for the driver to have held position off the pin and no ground to discount the shortfall.

evidence EV-ADVIS-00210-01, EV-GPS-00210 · clauses POL-NS-06

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-00210-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

discarded The chat export is gapped exactly across the handover. Its own sequence runs from MSG-00210-001 to MSG-00210-004, and the trip record records chat_message_count 4, but the export carries only 2 messages - so messages 002 and 003 are missing somewhere in the 23:42 to 23:49 window between the arrival notification and the rider's protest. POL-NS-08(c) makes that a policy-level impairment, and it bears directly on POL-NS-04(a), which asks what the rider sent during the waiting window: the export cannot show what was said at the moment the driver says he was waiting at Door 6, so no adverse reading of the rider's coordination can be taken from it. EV-CHAT-00210 is impaired (TRUNCATED_LOG, weight 0.6) and I disclose it.

evidence EV-CHAT-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-04

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-TRIP-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.4 but does not name its issue code(s): CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT

kept The trace carries no rider track at all (rider_presence.available is false), so the presence test in POL-NS-04(c) cannot be run. POL-NS-11 makes that UNDECIDABLE rather than failed: it is neither satisfied nor failed, POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on it, and the judge must say the test could not be run rather than inferring the rider was elsewhere. Nothing in this record affirmatively places the rider away from Door 6; the only rider message surviving in the export, sent at 23:49:40, is 'why cancel?? i was at door 6'. EV-GPS-00210 is impaired at weight 0.25 and EV-CHAT-00210 at 0.6 (TRUNCATED_LOG), as disclosed above.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-CHAT-00210 · clauses POL-NS-11, POL-NS-04

The driver advocate

kept The contested $6.00 is exactly the cancellation fee in force for an AIRPORT-zone no-show on this trip, and it reconciles with the fare breakdown's own derived money block: a zone-class fee of $6.00 against a charged cancellation line of $6.00, difference $0.00. There is therefore no fare integrity defect and POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged on the amount. The fare breakdown is COMPLETE at weight 1.0; the trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, which touches its arrival and dwell fields, not the charge amount.

evidence EV-FARE-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-01

kept The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event at 23:42:10 and shows the trip terminated by the driver at 23:49:05 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which satisfies POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d). The trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with issue code CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT: those two fields are the platform's own telemetry, nothing else in the bundle contradicts the reason code, and the rider's own filing does not assert that he boarded or that the driver chose any other reason code.

evidence EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-01

discarded The driver's trace contains 5 consecutive qualifying in-geofence fixes, more than the 3 consecutive in-radius fixes POL-NS-02 requires, with a minimum measured distance of 96.0 m from the pickup pin, inside the 150 m arrival radius that applies to the AIRPORT zone class. The trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD; the clock defect shifts timestamps rather than positions, so the in-radius fix count is untouched by the discount and POL-NS-02's proximity test is met.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-02, POL-NS-01

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-TRIP-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.4 but does not name its issue code(s): CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT

kept The record's own admissibility finding is that the driver device clock runs a known 228 s ahead of the server clock. Correcting the first qualifying in-geofence fix (device 23:42:21) by that known offset puts the driver inside the geofence at 23:38:33 server time, before the 23:42:10 arrived event, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is met; and the continuous dwell from that fix to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 632 s, above the 480 s free waiting period in force for this AIRPORT trip, so limb (c) is met also. Read at face value the same span is only 404 s, which is why the correction matters - and the 186 s gap running from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 sits exactly across geofence entry, so the export cannot be read at face value against the platform's own arrival event. The trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD, and the trip record is IMPAIRED at weight 0.4 with CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-08

discarded POL-NS-03 is not the governing clause. It applies only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and it always ends in a full refund of the fee. Here the qualifying fixes lie inside the 150 m AIRPORT radius, the closest at 96.0 m, so the wrong-entrance regime is not engaged and does not displace the fee.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-03, POL-NS-02

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.25 but does not name its issue code(s): CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD

kept POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Limb (a) requires a rider message that is locating or coordinating and sent during the waiting window; the only rider message surviving in the log is sent at 23:49:40, thirty-five seconds after the driver's 23:49:05 cancellation, and the only in-window message is the SYSTEM notice 'Your driver has arrived' at 23:42:11, which is not the rider's own. Limb (c) cannot be run at all, because the trace carries no rider_track, so under POL-NS-11 it is undecidable and neutral and cannot exonerate. The chat log is IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 with issue code TRUNCATED_LOG - messages 002 and 003 implied by its own sequence numbering are missing - and I disclose that: the gap cuts both ways, and neither the surviving text nor the trip record's chat_message_count of 4 identifies any rider locating message inside the window.

evidence EV-CHAT-00210, EV-GPS-00210 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11

discarded POL-NS-05 cannot be run on this record. It requires matching the 'arrived' event to a GPS fix, and the record's own finding is that the 228 s clock skew makes any such matching unsafe under POL-NS-08(a), which must be applied before POL-NS-05 can operate. On the corrected clock the driver was inside the 150 m radius at the arrival marker, so neither limb of the false-arrival test - more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above at that moment - is established. The trace is IMPAIRED at weight 0.25 with issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE and PARTIAL_RECORD.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-TRIP-00210 · clauses POL-NS-05, POL-NS-08

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-TRIP-00210 at weight_multiplier 0.4 but does not name its issue code(s): CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT

kept Where the fee stands, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the $6.00 fee in force, which is $4.80, and the anti-farming check does not trip on either limb: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 4-termination limb, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 156 is a rate of 0.013, far under the 0.08 limb. Those are exactly the two fields POL-NS-07 names, read as it names them.

evidence EV-DPROF-00210, EV-FARE-00210 · clauses POL-NS-07

discarded Even on the reading most hostile to the driver, the arrival and dwell facts rest solely on the GPS trace, and its impairment under POL-NS-08(a) (228 s clock skew) and POL-NS-08(b) (a 186 s gap inside the waiting window) takes the case at most to human review under POL-NS-09(e). Under POL-GEN-02(2) that single carrier caps confidence at 0.25, so it cannot alone support a ruling against the driver, and the disputed $6.00 is HELD rather than collected or refunded while review is pending. The driver's worst outcome on this record is a hold, not a refund to the rider.

evidence EV-GPS-00210, EV-FARE-00210 · clauses POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-02

Each draft's own explanation

To the rider and the driver: this case cannot be decided on the record as it stands, so the $6.00 no-show charge stays on hold (EV-FARE-00210 shows payment_status PENDING) — neither collected from the rider nor refunded — and it goes to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09. That is not a win for either of you; it means the one measurement that would settle the dispute is missing. What is disputed: the charge stands only if the driver held position inside the 150 m AIRPORT pickup radius for a continuous 480 seconds (8 minutes), measured under POL-NS-01(c) from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix — not from the driver's 'arrived' tap at 23:42:10 and not from the cancellation at 23:49:05. Why it cannot be decided: the only artifact that can give that measurement is the GPS trace EV-GPS-00210, and it is broken in four ways at once. Its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (CLOCK_SKEW — far over the 90-second limb in POL-NS-08(a)); a 186-second sampling gap runs from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 straight across the moment of geofence entry (GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW); coverage is 22.8% with 9 fixes over the trip (LOW_COVERAGE, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE); and the log stops at 23:46:36, 149 seconds before the cancellation, with no rider track at all (TRUNCATED_LOG, PARTIAL_RECORD). Read at face value the first qualifying fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell is 404 seconds — 76 seconds short. Corrected for the known 228-second skew the same fix is 23:38:33 and the dwell is 632 seconds — comfortably over. The gap hides the entry moment that would choose between those two answers, so the trace cannot choose. The only other artifact that speaks to arrival and dwell, the trip record EV-TRIP-00210, is also impaired (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4): its 23:42:10 arrival and its implied 6.9-minute (about 414-second) wait cannot be reconciled with the trace. The two artifacts therefore contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell, and no clause resolves the conflict: POL-NS-05 cannot be run because the 228-second skew makes matching the arrival marker to a fix unsafe (POL-NS-08(a) applies first), and POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. That is POL-NS-09(b); the same broken trace is also the sole evidence for the deciding fact, which is POL-NS-09(e). The driver's claims: he is right that the trip record carries an 'arrived' event and a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are present, but those fields do not decide the case — the fee turns on limbs (b) and (c), the geofence position and the dwell, which rest on the broken trace. His claim that the 228-second correction makes the dwell 632 seconds so limbs (b) and (c) hold, and that POL-NS-07 would fix his payout at 80% of the $6.00 fee = $4.80, is noted but rests entirely on the impaired trace (weight 0.25) and the impaired trip record (0.4), so under POL-GEN-02(2) it cannot carry a ruling against the rider. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 2, below 4; 2/156 = 0.013, below 0.08), so no POL-NS-07 escalation instruction arises. The rider's claims: his point that the trip record's own arithmetic (23:42:10 to 23:49:05 = 415 seconds, or the recorded 6.9-minute wait) falls short of 480 seconds is noted, but that arithmetic measures from the arrival tap, which POL-NS-01(c) forbids, and the trip record is itself impaired at 0.4, so it cannot establish the shortfall either. His POL-NS-04 argument cannot help him: the only rider message surviving in the chat is 'why cancel?? i was at door 6' at 23:49:40, 35 seconds after the 23:49:05 cancellation and so not during the waiting window, and with no rider track the presence test cannot be run at all — it is neutral, exactly as POL-NS-11 says. Confidence: the dwell fact rests on EV-GPS-00210 at weight 0.25 (issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD — impaired both at schema level and under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) and (b)) and on EV-TRIP-00210 at weight 0.4 (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT). The cap is the minimum, 0.25, below the 0.70 platform floor; even on the more generous 0.4 it would still be below the floor. EV-FARE-00210 is complete at 1.0 but carries only the $6.00 amount, which reconciles with the AIRPORT zone fee, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged on the money. Reviewer: the open question is the driver's continuous in-geofence dwell, measured from the first admissible in-geofence fix and reconciled to server time, against the 480-second minimum for an AIRPORT pickup; the 228-second clock skew and the missing GPS coverage across geofence entry (device 23:39:15–23:42:21) are what must be obtained. The monetary effect is nil, so POL-GEN-05 is not engaged. Either party may use the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.
To both parties — here is what this ruling does and why. OUTCOME. The $6.00 no-show charge is HELD: it is not collected from the rider and not refunded to him while a human reviewer decides the case. No driver compensation is paid at this stage. This is an escalation under POL-NS-09, which is terminal for the automated pipeline. WHY THE FEE CANNOT BE DECIDED ON THIS RECORD. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold. The two in dispute are (b) that the trace placed the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before the arrival event, and (c) that he then held position for the free waiting period in force, which for this AIRPORT pickup is 480 seconds (trip record platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap, so the dwell is the deciding fact. The only artifact that measures it is EV-GPS-00210, and it is impaired for policy purposes, not merely at schema level: - POL-NS-08(a): the driver device clock runs 228 s ahead of the server, more than double that limb's 90 s threshold, so no fix can be safely matched to the arrival or termination event; - POL-NS-08(b): a 186 s sampling gap straddles geofence entry, and only 5 fixes fall inside the waiting window against the 6 the limb requires. Read at face value the trace puts the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 23:42:21 and the dwell at 404 s — 76 s short of 480 s. Corrected for the 228 s skew the same fix is 23:38:33 and the dwell is 632 s — comfortably over. The gap conceals the one fact that would choose between the two, and nothing else in the bundle supplies it. Because the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(b), POL-NS-09(e) applies and the case goes to human review. Two further triggers point the same way: the trip record and the trace contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell (POL-NS-09(b)), and POL-NS-05 cannot be run to recompute the waiting clock because the very skew that would have to be corrected makes the arrival-to-fix match unsafe; and confidence is capped at the trace's weight of 0.25 under POL-GEN-02(2), below the 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) applies as well. ON YOUR CLAIMS. Driver's points. Your limb (a)/(d) point is correct as far as it goes: the trip record carries an arrival event at 23:42:10 and a driver termination at 23:49:05 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so limbs (a) and (d) are met. Your fare-integrity point is also correct: the $6.00 charged equals the $6.00 AIRPORT zone fee and reconciles with the fare line, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged on the amount (EV-FARE-00210, COMPLETE, weight 1.0). But your central point — that correcting the 228 s skew puts the driver in the geofence at 23:38:33 and yields a 632 s dwell — I cannot accept. POL-NS-08(a) treats that skew as disabling, and the policy does not let a party re-time a trace through it; the 186 s gap runs exactly across geofence entry, so whether the driver was inside at the arrival moment is unobserved rather than proved. Limbs (b) and (c) are therefore undecided, not satisfied. Your POL-NS-07 compensation claim ($4.80 = 80 percent of $6.00; anti-farming not tripped at 2 no_show_terminations_30d against 156 completed_trips_30d, a rate of 0.013) is arithmetically right on the two fields that clause names, but compensation issues only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which it is not here. Rider's points. Your point that the driver cannot be exonerated on the contact limb, and the driver's matching point, are accepted: the trace carries no rider_track (rider_presence.available is false), so POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot be run, and under POL-NS-11 it is undecidable and neutral — neither satisfied nor failed — and POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on it. Your remaining point — that the trip record's own arithmetic (wait_time_min 6.9, about 414 s, roughly 66 s short of 480 s) proves the shortfall — I cannot accept either. That record is itself impaired (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4, on precisely its arrived_at and implied-wait fields), so under POL-NS-08 it cannot alone support a ruling against the party it disfavours; it and the trace disagree about the size of the shortfall, and that disagreement is unresolvable on this bundle. For completeness: EV-CHAT-00210 is impaired (TRUNCATED_LOG, weight 0.6; messages 002 and 003 implied by its own sequence and by chat_message_count of 4 are missing) and EV-ADVIS-00210-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), which makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable — but neither carries the dwell, and the missing advisory exonerates no one. The open question for the reviewer: on the platform's full-resolution record, did the driver's device hold position inside the 150 m Changi T1 arrival radius continuously for 480 s before the 23:49:05 cancellation — that is, is the true first in-geofence fix 23:42:21 (404 s, short) or 23:38:33 (632 s, sufficient)? The reviewer should obtain the full-resolution GPS stream and the missing chat messages 002-003. REFERRALS. None. No clause of this policy directs one on these facts: POL-NS-05(ii) (false-arrival record) does not fire because qualifying in-geofence fixes exist and POL-NS-05 cannot be run through the skew, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. This ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days. The $6.00 fee (fare_breakdown payment_status PENDING) stays on hold: not collected and not refunded meanwhile.
To the rider and to the driver: I cannot settle this charge on the evidence in the file, so under POL-NS-09 I am sending the case to a human reviewer. To the rider and the driver: the $6.00 Changi Terminal 1 no-show fee cannot be decided on this record. It is held — not collected from the rider and not refunded to him — and the case goes to a human reviewer. No driver compensation is paid. Why. The fee is chargeable only if all four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold. Two are not in dispute. Limb (a): the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 23:42:10. Limb (d): the trip terminated at 23:49:05 by the driver with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The undecided condition is limb (c), a continuous dwell of at least 480 seconds — the free waiting period in force for this AIRPORT trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 480). The only artifact that can measure that dwell is the driver's GPS trace, EV-GPS-00210, and it is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a) and (b): its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (the threshold is 90 seconds); a 186-second sampling gap runs from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21, straight across the moment of geofence entry; and only five fixes fall inside the waiting window, fewer than the six POL-NS-08(b) requires. Its weight is 0.25. Because the skew exceeds 90 seconds, POL-NS-08(a) applies before POL-NS-05, so the waiting clock cannot be recomputed and the false-arrival test cannot be run in either direction. The trace therefore cannot say whether the dwell was long enough, and its two readings point opposite ways. At face value its first qualifying in-geofence fix is 23:42:21 and the run to the last fix at 23:46:36 lasts 255 seconds — short of 480. Corrected by the known 228-second skew the same fix is 23:38:33 server time and the dwell to the 23:49:05 cancellation is 632 seconds — over 480. The 186-second gap conceals the one measurement that would choose between them, and the trace is the sole evidence that can make that choice. The platform's trip record, EV-TRIP-00210, does not break the tie. It is itself impaired (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4) and it contradicts the trace directly: it records arrived_at 23:42:10 with an implied wait of 6.9 minutes, about 415 seconds from the tap, while the trace places the first in-geofence fix later still. Two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell and no clause resolves it (POL-NS-09(b)), and the sole evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) (POL-NS-09(e)). POL-NS-08 accordingly caps the outcome at PARTIAL_REFUND and directs the case to review rather than to a payment either way. On the parties' points. The rider says the trip record's own arithmetic shows a shortfall — 23:42:10 to 23:49:05 with wait_time_min 6.9, about 66 seconds under the 480-second minimum. That arithmetic is right, and I accept it as far as it goes, but it does not decide the case: limb (c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 23:42:10 arrival tap, the trip record is impaired and contradicts the trace, and only the trace can fix the geofence-entry moment. The point is answered but outweighed, and it does not by itself refund the fee. Both sides agree the rider's own track is absent (rider_presence.available is false), so the presence test in POL-NS-04(c) could not be run. That is right: under POL-NS-11 the test is undecidable and neutral, and POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider on it. It changes no amount. The driver says the $6.00 reconciles with the AIRPORT cancellation fee and that POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. Accepted — EV-FARE-00210 is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 and the charged cancellation line is $6.00. The driver says limbs (a) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are met. Accepted, as above; but they do not by themselves make the fee chargeable while limb (c) is undecided. The driver says his clock correction puts him inside the geofence at 23:38:33 and gives a 632-second dwell, so limbs (b) and (c) are met. Rejected. That correction is exactly what POL-NS-08(a) forbids the case to rely on: with the skew over 90 seconds the arrival event cannot be safely matched to a fix and POL-NS-05 cannot be run, so the 632-second dwell is an assumption the 186-second gap conceals, not a measurement. The driver says POL-NS-07 fixes his payout at 80 percent of $6.00 — $4.80 — and that the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d of 2 is below 4, and 2 over 156 completed trips is 0.013, below 0.08). That reading of the two named fields is correct, but POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, which cannot be found here, so no compensation issues now. The $6.00 is held pending review. The reviewer is asked to settle one question: was the driver continuously inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius for at least 480 seconds before the 23:49:05 cancellation, and what is the correct server-time reading of EV-GPS-00210 across the 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 gap? A full-resolution GPS export, or the platform's own arrival and wait-timer records, would answer it.

The judge's explanation, verbatim

To the rider and the driver: this case cannot be decided on the record as it stands, so the $6.00 no-show charge stays on hold (EV-FARE-00210 shows payment_status PENDING) — neither collected from the rider nor refunded — and it goes to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09. That is not a win for either of you; it means the one measurement that would settle the dispute is missing. What is disputed: the charge stands only if the driver held position inside the 150 m AIRPORT pickup radius for a continuous 480 seconds (8 minutes), measured under POL-NS-01(c) from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix — not from the driver's 'arrived' tap at 23:42:10 and not from the cancellation at 23:49:05. Why it cannot be decided: the only artifact that can give that measurement is the GPS trace EV-GPS-00210, and it is broken in four ways at once. Its device clock runs 228 seconds ahead of the server (CLOCK_SKEW — far over the 90-second limb in POL-NS-08(a)); a 186-second sampling gap runs from 23:39:15 to 23:42:21 straight across the moment of geofence entry (GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW); coverage is 22.8% with 9 fixes over the trip (LOW_COVERAGE, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE); and the log stops at 23:46:36, 149 seconds before the cancellation, with no rider track at all (TRUNCATED_LOG, PARTIAL_RECORD). Read at face value the first qualifying fix is 23:42:21 and the dwell is 404 seconds — 76 seconds short. Corrected for the known 228-second skew the same fix is 23:38:33 and the dwell is 632 seconds — comfortably over. The gap hides the entry moment that would choose between those two answers, so the trace cannot choose. The only other artifact that speaks to arrival and dwell, the trip record EV-TRIP-00210, is also impaired (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT, weight 0.4): its 23:42:10 arrival and its implied 6.9-minute (about 414-second) wait cannot be reconciled with the trace. The two artifacts therefore contradict each other directly on arrival and dwell, and no clause resolves the conflict: POL-NS-05 cannot be run because the 228-second skew makes matching the arrival marker to a fix unsafe (POL-NS-08(a) applies first), and POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. That is POL-NS-09(b); the same broken trace is also the sole evidence for the deciding fact, which is POL-NS-09(e). The driver's claims: he is right that the trip record carries an 'arrived' event and a RIDER_NO_SHOW termination, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are present, but those fields do not decide the case — the fee turns on limbs (b) and (c), the geofence position and the dwell, which rest on the broken trace. His claim that the 228-second correction makes the dwell 632 seconds so limbs (b) and (c) hold, and that POL-NS-07 would fix his payout at 80% of the $6.00 fee = $4.80, is noted but rests entirely on the impaired trace (weight 0.25) and the impaired trip record (0.4), so under POL-GEN-02(2) it cannot carry a ruling against the rider. The anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d 2, below 4; 2/156 = 0.013, below 0.08), so no POL-NS-07 escalation instruction arises. The rider's claims: his point that the trip record's own arithmetic (23:42:10 to 23:49:05 = 415 seconds, or the recorded 6.9-minute wait) falls short of 480 seconds is noted, but that arithmetic measures from the arrival tap, which POL-NS-01(c) forbids, and the trip record is itself impaired at 0.4, so it cannot establish the shortfall either. His POL-NS-04 argument cannot help him: the only rider message surviving in the chat is 'why cancel?? i was at door 6' at 23:49:40, 35 seconds after the 23:49:05 cancellation and so not during the waiting window, and with no rider track the presence test cannot be run at all — it is neutral, exactly as POL-NS-11 says. Confidence: the dwell fact rests on EV-GPS-00210 at weight 0.25 (issue codes CLOCK_SKEW, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE, TRUNCATED_LOG, LOW_SAMPLE_RATE, PARTIAL_RECORD — impaired both at schema level and under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) and (b)) and on EV-TRIP-00210 at weight 0.4 (CROSS_SOURCE_CONFLICT). The cap is the minimum, 0.25, below the 0.70 platform floor; even on the more generous 0.4 it would still be below the floor. EV-FARE-00210 is complete at 1.0 but carries only the $6.00 amount, which reconciles with the AIRPORT zone fee, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged on the money. Reviewer: the open question is the driver's continuous in-geofence dwell, measured from the first admissible in-geofence fix and reconciled to server time, against the 480-second minimum for an AIRPORT pickup; the 228-second clock skew and the missing GPS coverage across geofence entry (device 23:39:15–23:42:21) are what must be obtained. The monetary effect is nil, so POL-GEN-05 is not engaged. Either party may use the appeal route under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Under POL-GEN-02(2) that single carrier caps confidence at 0.25, so it cannot alone support a ruling against the driver, and the disputed $6.00 is HELD rather than collected or refunded while review is pending. The driver's worst outcome on this record is a hold, not a refund to the rider. DISCARDED
